nodes.name: Maligaro's Sanctum
nodes.summary: A map-like area in Act 7 entered through portals opened with Maligaro's Map from the Chamber of Sins; the Artist Maligaro and his pet spider Black Death are fought here.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'You have opened the portals using his Map, now enter Maligaro's Sanctum.'
Walkthrough: 'Maligaro's Sanctum is a map-like area. Player consumes one portal to enter the area'

nodes.name: The Dread Thicket
nodes.summary: An Act 7 area in the Northern Forest where the Fireflies needed for Yeena's Fire Dew are found.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Search for the Firefly in the The Dread Thicket (Act 7), then deliver Firefly to Yeena.'
Progression table: 'The Dread Thicket (Act 7) 53' branching from The Northern Forest (Act 7)

nodes.name: The Canals
nodes.summary: The Act 10 waterways of Oriath, behind Kitava's Horns, where Kitava feeds; Innocence opens the way to them and the Feeding Trough lies there.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Kitava, the Insatiable's Horns block the way to the The Canals where Kitava, the Insatiable feeds.'

edges.description: The exile arrives back in Wraeclast at Lioneye's Watch, the Act 6 town.

sources.locator: Intro: 'its town is Lioneye's Watch'; Progression table starts at Lioneye's Watch

edges.description: Lilly Roth, first met on the Cathedral Rooftop at the end of Act 5, offers the exile a lift to Lioneye's Watch at the start of Act 6.

sources.locator: Intro: 'She then offers a lift to Lioneye's Watch in Act 6'

edges.description: Sin, the exile's divine guide, sets the task of harvesting souls for the Dark Ember at the start of Act 6.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, opening Sin dialogue: 'How do we obtain this Dark Ember? ... All I need are three fine souls'

edges.description: The exile enters the Karui Fortress and Tukohama's Keep to reach and kill Tukohama.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Find the exit to the the Karui Fortress... Tukohama's Keep, in the middle of the map'

edges.description: Tarkleigh points the exile to the Karui Fortress through the Eye of Conquest and rewards the kill of Tukohama.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Tarkleigh: 'I'd see about putting that eye back where it belongs' and 'You've killed the Karui war god?'

edges.description: The exile enters Axiom Prison and kills Shavronne's spirit in her tower there.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Sin wants you to find the spirit of Shavronne of Umbra in her tower in the Prison and kill her.'

edges.description: Sin harvests Shavronne's soul for the Dark Ember once she is killed.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'You have killed Shavronne and Sin has harvested her soul.'

edges.description: The exile fights Abberath, the Cloven One, at Prisoner's Gate.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Bestel has asked you to defeat Abberath, the Cloven God, at Prisoner's Gate.'

edges.description: Bestel asks the exile to kill Abberath and rewards the kill with a passive skill point.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Bestel'; Walkthrough: 'Bestel has asked you to defeat Abberath'

edges.description: The exile reaches the Brine King's Reef on the Black Crest and fights the Brine King there.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'After arriving at the Brine King's Reef, search for Nessa... After finding Nessa in The Brine King's Reef you have to defeat the boss.'

edges.description: Nessa, cursed into a mermaid by the Brine King, is freed at the reef and calls the exile her new sister.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Nessa at the reef: 'So courageous, such a fine example of womanhood... Thank you, my new sister.'

edges.description: Weylam Roth summons from the Black Flag and sails the exile on the Black Crest to the Brine King's reef.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Weylam Roth at the Beacon: 'Of course I'll ferry you to the Brine King's blood reef.'

edges.description: Tarkleigh starts the quest by sending the exile to find the missing Nessa.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start 'Speak to Tarkleigh'; Walkthrough: 'Nessa... Please, find Nessa. Bring her back to us.'

edges.description: Sin appears after the Brine King is defeated.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'After defeating The Brine King Sin will appear'

edges.description: The exile enters Maligaro's Sanctum through portals opened with his Map and kills him there.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'You have opened the portals using his Map, now enter Maligaro's Sanctum.'

edges.description: Sin harvests Maligaro's soul after he is killed.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'You have killed Maligaro and Sin has harvested his soul.'

edges.description: The exile kills Black Death and Maligaro in the Sanctum to take the Black Venom.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Search for it in Maligaro's Sanctum' / 'Kill it and Maligaro to obtain some Black Venom.'

edges.description: The Black Venom is delivered to Silk in the Chamber of Sins Level 1.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Deliver the Black Venom to Silk in the The Chamber of Sins Level 1 (Act 7)'

edges.description: Silk asks the exile to take the Black Venom and rewards the delivery with the Obsidian key.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Silk in Act 7'; Silk: 'Please, will you find him, kill this Black Death, take the eight-leg's venom for me?'

edges.description: Maligaro is killed together with his pet spider Black Death in the Web of Secrets quest.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: 'boss1=Maligaro, the Artist', 'boss2=Black Death, Pain Unending'

edges.description: The exile kills the possessed Greust in the Forest Encampment to drive Ralakesh back into the relic.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Ralakesh is located in The Forest Encampment which connects The Ashen Fields and The Northern Forest.'

edges.description: Greust, possessed by Ralakesh as its avatar, is the enemy the exile must kill.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Ralakesh ... has possessed Greust... You must kill Greust to defeat Ralakesh.'

edges.description: Eramir starts the quest, translating the relic's inscriptions and urging the exile to destroy the god.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Eramir in the The Bridge Encampment'; Eramir: 'Please, I urge you to destroy this god'

edges.description: The exile gathers the seven Fireflies in the Dread Thicket.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Search for the Firefly in the The Dread Thicket (Act 7)'

edges.description: The Fireflies are delivered to Yeena in the Vaal City, at the entrance to Arakaali's temple.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Getting to Yeena from the The Dread Thicket... Yeena is located inside The Vaal City'

edges.description: Yeena asks for seven Fireflies to brew Fire Dew and burn open Arakaali's temple.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Yeena: 'Yeena needs seven Firefly to burn open the entrance to Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows temple.'

edges.description: The exile burns through the webs and kills Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay, failing to save Silk.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay to save Silk.'

edges.description: Silk is consorting with Arakaali and is lost when she is killed.

sources.locator: Silk: 'My bride has arrived, exile!'; log: 'You have killed Arakaali and gained access to Act 8, but failed to save Silk.'

edges.description: Yeena, who brewed the Fire Dew, accompanies the exile to Arakaali's temple.

sources.locator: Yeena: 'Now I must return to Broken Bridge... We will speak more of Silk and sorrow then.' and Walkthrough: Yeena's warning about Silk and Arakaali

edges.description: The exile kills Doedre in the Cauldron boss arena of Doedre's Cesspool.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'In the Toxic Conduits, you will find an area called Doedre's Cesspool... This is the boss arena.'

edges.description: Sin wants Doedre killed so he can harvest her soul and does so after her death.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'After defeating Doedre the Vile, Sin harvests her soul.'

edges.description: Hargan tells the exile where Doedre hides in the Toxic Conduits and gives the reward.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'If you speak with Hargan, he tells you that Doedre can be found somewhere in the Toxic Conduits.'

edges.description: The exile searches the Lunaris Temple for the Moon Orb carried by Dusk.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Search the The Lunaris Temple Level 2 (Act 8) for the Moon Orb'

edges.description: Maramoa sends the exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Moon Orb.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Maramoa'

edges.description: Dusk, an exile devotee of Lunaris, carried the Moon Orb into the Lunaris Temple and keeps it from the exile.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: 'boss=Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris'; objective: 'KIll Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris and take the Moon Orb'

edges.description: The exile searches the Solaris Temple for the Sun Orb guarded by Dawn.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Search the The Solaris Temple Level 1 for the Sun Orb'

edges.description: Maramoa sends the exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Sun Orb.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Maramoa'

edges.description: Dawn, an exile devotee of Solaris, guards the Sun Orb in her temple.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: 'boss=Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris'; Maramoa: 'The Sun Orb lies within her temple, guarded by her most ardent devotee... 'The Dawn'.'

edges.description: With both orbs, the exile summons Solaris and Lunaris in the Sky Shrine on the Harbour Bridge and kills them.

sources.locator: Intro: 'They can be found in the Sky Shrine in the center of The Harbour Bridge once the Moon Orb and Sun Orb have been retrieved'

edges.description: Sin speaks after the twin goddesses fall, declaring the sun and moon back in their rightful places.

sources.locator: Completion dialogue, Sin: 'Sun and Moon return to their rightful places, leaving our path now clear.'

edges.description: The exile meets Sin at the Quarry, where he burns open the way into the Beast.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at the The Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance into the The Belly of the Beast (Act 9).'

edges.description: The quest's boss fight against the Depraved Trinity takes place in the Rotting Core inside the Beast.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin to manifest the Depraved Trinity' inside the Black Core

edges.description: Sin, in Highgate, sends the exile for the ingredients and then brews and opens the Beast with them.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Sin in Highgate: 'Sin needs you to find some Trarthan Powder and Basilisk Acid'

edges.description: Lilly Roth offers to ferry the exile to Oriath after the Trinity dies.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Lilly Roth: 'Say the words and we'll set the sails.'

edges.description: Sin burns the new entrance into the Beast's corpse at the Quarry.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at The Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance'

edges.description: The entrance leads into the Belly of the Beast (Act 9).

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Sin has burned open a new entrance into the The Belly of the Beast (Act 9).'

edges.description: Sin burns the Beast's flank with the basilisk acid and powder mixture to open the way in.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'I shall apply this fermentation to the weakened membrane'

edges.description: The Depraved Trinity is fought and destroyed in the Rotting Core.

sources.locator: Infobox: 'location = The Rotting Core'; intro: 'the final boss of Act 9, located in The Rotting Core'

edges.description: Sin manifests the Depraved Trinity from the three harvested souls and urges its destruction.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin to manifest the Depraved Trinity'; Sin: 'Destroy that creature of darkness'

edges.description: Shavronne of Umbra is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.

sources.locator: Intro: 'The Trinity is the combined power of the three lieutenants of Malachai... Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: Maligaro is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.

sources.locator: Intro: 'Doedre Stamatis, Maligaro, and Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: Doedre is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.

sources.locator: Intro: 'the three lieutenants of Malachai... Doedre Stamatis, Maligaro, and Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: The exile lands at Oriath Docks, where Lani greets them.

sources.locator: Intro: 'its town is Oriath Docks'; Lani: 'Landing on the docks, the exile is greeted by Lani' (NPC list)

edges.description: Lilly Roth ferries the exile back to Oriath.

sources.locator: Intro: 'the exile returns to Oriath, courtesy of Lilly Roth'

edges.description: Lani describes how Vilenta betrayed her and Bannon and led Kitava's cultists to the Overseer's Tower.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Lani: 'That witch, Vilenta, is to blame. She lowered a secret ladder'
Intro: 'Landing on the docks, the exile is greeted by Lani'

edges.description: The exile saves Bannon from Kitava's cultists on the Cathedral Rooftop.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Bannon is trapped on the The Cathedral Rooftop (Act 10) by the cultists of Kitava.'

edges.description: Lani asks the exile to find Bannon and return him to her.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Lani: 'If you are going that way, perhaps you can find him and return him to me.'

edges.description: Kitava's cultists surround Bannon and Lani and are the enemies the exile fights on the rooftop.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Bannon: 'Kitava's cultists surrounded Lani and I a while back'

edges.description: Bannon meets the exile at the docks with the Staff of Purity and sacrifices himself there to resurrect Innocence.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Bring it to him at the Oriath Docks.'

edges.description: Bannon uses the Staff of Purity and sacrifices himself to host the reborn Innocence.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Bannon: 'In this act, I will become his host in the fullest sense'; log: 'Bannon has used the Staff of Purity ... and sacrificed himself'

edges.description: Innocence destroys Kitava's Horns at the Ravaged Square.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Meet Innocence at the Horns in the The Ravaged Square'

edges.description: Innocence destroys the black gates blocking the Canals with his power.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Innocence: 'Innocence will use his power to destroy Kitava's Horns'

edges.description: The exile finds Kitava at his Feeding Trough and kills him there.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'You have found Kitava at his Feeding Trough. Talk to Sin to begin the final battle.'

edges.description: Kitava is searched for and destroyed in the Canals.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Search The Canals for Kitava and destroy Kitava, the Insatiable once and for all.'

edges.description: Sin begins the final battle and congratulates the exile after Kitava falls.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Sin: 'This is it... Go Exile, together we will save humankind!'

edges.description: Innocence, reborn, fights alongside the exile against Kitava.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Innocence: 'Though my brother and I will aid you, I sense the universe conspires'

edges.description: Lilly Roth offers to sail the exile away from Oriath, with a line tailored to the exile's class.

sources.locator: Walkthrough, Lilly Roth: 'Whaddya say, Marauder? ... Just say the word, and we'll set sail.'

edges.description: The exile reaches Karui Shores and begins the Atlas of Worlds tutorial.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time, talk to Helena.'

edges.description: Helena directs the exile to the War Room on Karui Shores.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time, talk to Helena. She will direct the player to the War Room'

edges.description: Commander Kirac gives the exile the first Tier 1 map to use on the Map Device.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'talk to Commander Kirac. He will give the player a Tier 1 map.'
